svg.aria-label: Patients carry different sets of tests, so no single input space exists. Dropping to shared columns, imputing, one model per group and modality fusion each give up a property; the proposed method keeps all measured data, invents nothing and couples groups even when they share no test, by giving each group its own encoder into one shared latent space with class anchors, and it protects the group furthest from its own achievable loss rather than the group with the highest loss.
svg.text: Group 4 shares no test with the others
(b) One model for everyone: the options
(c) Ours: share in a latent space, not at the input
